+"""Standalone option prefix splitting.
+
+Mirrors the behavior of ``click.parser._split_opt`` without importing
+``click.parser``, so it stays usable once that module is removed. Unlike
+the original, a prefix character repeated three times is consumed whole.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+__all__ = ["split_triple_option"]
+
+
+def split_triple_option(opt: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    """Split an option string into its prefix and name.
+
+    An alphanumeric first character means there is no prefix. Otherwise
+    up to three repeats of the first character form the prefix.
+
+    :param opt: The option string, such as ``"--name"`` or ``"---name"``.
+    :return: A ``(prefix, name)`` tuple.
+    """
+    first = opt[:1]
+    if first.isalnum():
+        return "", opt
+    if opt[1:2] == first:
+        if opt[2:3] == first:
+            return opt[:3], opt[3:]
+        return opt[:2], opt[2:]
+    return first, opt[1:]

@@ -0,0 +1,63 @@
+import importlib.util
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+_PATH = Path(__file__).parents[1] / "src" / "standalone_triple_dash_option.py"
+
+
+def _load():
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
+        "standalone_triple_dash_option", _PATH
+    )
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+split_triple_option = _load().split_triple_option
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("opt", "expect"),
+    [
+        ("", ("", "")),
+        ("a", ("", "a")),
+        ("abc", ("", "abc")),
+        ("1x", ("", "1x")),
+        ("-", ("-", "")),
+        ("-a", ("-", "a")),
+        ("--", ("--", "")),
+        ("--name", ("--", "name")),
+        ("---", ("---", "")),
+        ("---name", ("---", "name")),
+        ("----name", ("---", "-name")),
+        ("+++x", ("+++", "x")),
+        ("//x", ("//", "x")),
+        ("-+-x", ("-", "+-x")),
+        ("--+x", ("--", "+x")),
+    ],
+)
+def test_split_triple_option(opt, expect):
+    assert split_triple_option(opt) == expect
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "opt", ["", "a", "-", "-a", "--", "--name", "+x", "++x", "-+x", "//", "1"]
+)
+def test_matches_reference_outside_triple_prefix(opt):
+    from click.parser import _split_opt
+
+    assert split_triple_option(opt) == _split_opt(opt)
+
+
+def test_does_not_import_click_parser():
+    code = (
+        "import importlib.util, sys\n"
+        f"spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m', {str(_PATH)!r})\n"
+        "spec.loader.exec_module(importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec))\n"
+        "assert 'click' not in sys.modules\n"
+    )
+    subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", code], check=True)
